title: Penalty for abetting or instigating an offence, and such others
chapter: Chapter VIII — Offences, Penalties, and Trial
text: Penalty for abetting or instigating an offence, and such others.— (1) If a person or a recruitment agent directly or indirectly abets or instigates an offence under this Act, and if the act of offence is committed as consequence o f that abetment or instigation, the concerned abettor or instigator shall be liable to receive the same punishment as the perpetrator of the crime or the offender.
source: Overseas Employment and Migrants Act 2013 (official English translation)
